removedWrongBinding.objectiveJa: ランナー発生の二条件、自然条件での花芽分化と翌年の開花、分化促進の条件と掲載育苗名を区別できる。
removedWrongBinding.reuseReasonJa: 本文の対象を「施設果菜と高設イチゴの外観」で観察し、作業・利用の違いを説明します。図は本文にない条件を追加するものではありません。
removedWrongBinding.scopeReasonJa: 既存図の対象・位置の観察を本課の基礎事項に限定して使い、図中の出典別条件を他の級の操作指示へ広げません。

actualDefect: Greenhouse fruit/high-bed appearance does not depict runner triggers or floral differentiation. Correct greenhouse primary and other supported crop contexts retained.
replacement: Native OR alternatives for completed flowering/fruiting or excess nutrition; natural low-temperature/short-day autumn differentiation separated from following-spring high-temperature/long-day flowering/fruiting; induction examples and4 nursery names separate. No temperatures, days, fertilizer-stop schedule or universal guarantee added.

visualQA.scope: Actual component/source relationships and separately generated concept-label preview checked; no browser/device or complete responsive-layout acceptance.
